title: Senior Manager, Label Services Order to Cash
description: At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members.

raw.title: Senior Manager, Label Services Order to Cash
raw.excerpt: At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members.
raw.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

A little bit about our team:

Warner Music's Center of Excellence for Shared Services is the home to the financial, legal and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our US Recorded Music and Publishing businesses. The Finance Department is responsible for managing all of the center's accounting and cash management functions.

As a critical component of Finance, the Order to Cash (OTC) team is responsible for measuring and monitoring financial risk related to the extension of credit terms, and for the timely recovery and efficient application of incoming cash (receivables). This role is fully remote.


Your role:

Lead Label Services Order to Cash end to end for merch, licensing, label and related receivables in the Americas: cash application, credit for venues and other third parties, collections for tour settlements, disputes and deductions. You will lead a hybrid team of onshore and offshore resources as the day-to-day owner of priorities, SLAs and quality, and you will represent OTC with WMG label management and label finance teams (for example, Atlantic), tour venues and their merch vendors, and internal audit. You will own the key controls and audit readiness for Label Services. You will identify where processes rely on manual workarounds, quantify their labor and control impact, and work with the Global Process Owners and Finance to redesign them in SAP S/4HANA rather than adding new workarounds. You will work closely with the Director, OTC and report to the Senior Director, OTC.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the Label Services OTC operation: set weekly priorities, SLAs and KPIs for the onshore analysts and the offshore team, and run a regular performance cadence.
  • Direct the offshore team on the recording, coding, depositing, researching and application of checks and transactions for US and Canada D2C and Tour Merch in SAP S/4HANA.
  • Lead calls and working sessions with label, finance, legal and tax partners, and make sure the team arrives prepared with accurate information.
  • Assess team capacity and skills. Coach, develop and hire onshore talent, and recommend the right onshore and offshore mix as volume grows.
  • Onboard mergers and acquisitions, including newly acquired labels, entities and affiliates, into OTC processes.
  • Own collections for the assigned customer portfolio, including large retail customers, third-party distributors and sellers, and tour venues and their merch vendors. Reconcile AtVenu tour settlements (gross sales, venue cuts, fees and tax) to cash received, and follow up against settlement payment terms. Manage aging, escalation and referral of uncollectible debt for write-off.
  • Ensure unallocated and unidentified cash receipts, including tour settlement payments, are researched and applied to the correct show and artist on time.
  • Manage D2C chargebacks and return authorizations for Tour Merch, and customer deductions and disputes against agreements and invoices, with clear owners and response deadlines. Quantify and report exposure and recovery.
  • Oversee Revenue processes including Managed Tour, Tour Supply, and Merch. Follow artist tour schedules and work with Tour Managers to oversee and reconcile cash receipts.
  • Liaise between the outsource provider and Labels and Artist management companies, including reviewing and approving touch-points and correspondence.
  • Run customer credit reviews and limits, including trade credit insurance submissions, and provide input to the bad debt provision. Apply the global credit policy and delegation of authority.
  • Own the Label Services key controls, including label approval and customer correspondence controls. Make sure evidence is complete and on time, and respond to internal audit and external auditor requests.
  • Reconcile accounts to support period-end close and year-end adjustments.
  • Partner with the Global Process Owners and Finance to log, force rank and retire manual workarounds. Define requirements, testing and sign-off for SAP S/4HANA changes.
  • Support worldwide merch licensing billing and collections.
  • Build reporting for aging, DSO, unapplied cash, chargebacks and SLA performance for Tour Supply, Managed Tour and VIP collections, and give regular progress updates to senior management.
  • Monitor the outsource provider's contract-level deliverables and escalate concerns to the Senior Director, OTC as needed.
  • Partner with Participations and Label Finance to ensure accurate tour and merch related artist statements are reconciled.
  • Maintain any VIP or Tour schedules, accruals, or other supporting analytics necessary to record revenue and expenses with the GBS RTR team.

About you:

  • 5+ years of progressive OTC experience in a Shared Services environment.
  • 3+ years of OTC people leader experience, including management of an outsourced BPO service provider.
  • Strong, hands-on SAP S/4HANA experience in Receivables, including invoicing, cash application and deduction or dispute handling.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and 2+ years of experience working with front-line Record Labels in supporting merch, managed tour, tour supply, and VIP structures for off and on roster artists.
  • Proven ownership of key controls and audit support (SOX or equivalent).
  • Experience with high-volume retail or wholesale customer accounts, including deductions, chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Excellent internal and external oral and written communication skills. Able to negotiate successfully and build lasting relationships that facilitate the collection process.
  • Analytical, detail oriented, highly organized and highly accurate. Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to manipulate data in a heavy-volume spreadsheet environment.
  • Ability to see the big picture, prioritize multiple projects simultaneously, make collection decisions quickly and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience writing procedure manuals and preparing departmental goals and objectives.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Knowledge of the music industry, including labels, artist management, touring and merch.
  • Experience with AR, credit and customer service software such as AtVenu or CashPro, and with Workiva or similar control evidence tools.
  • Experience with process improvement, automation or AI-enabled workflows in finance operations.
  • Experience onboarding acquired entities.
  • BA/BS degree in accounting, business, finance, computer science, systems or a related field highly preferred.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

Aerospike is looking for a technically adept Technical Account Manager (TAM) to help customers maximize the value of our real-time data platform. The TAM will be the trusted advisor for our customers, ensuring they achieve their business objectives while leveraging Aerospike’s technology effectively. This role is responsible for guiding customers through their journey with Aerospike, optimizing their deployments, and proactively resolving technical challenges. You'll build deep familiarity with each customer's technical environment, business objectives, and path to long-term success with Aerospike.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically skilled, and passionate about delivering a best-in-class customer experience.

This is a post-sales position.

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for strategic customers, ensuring they successfully adopt and optimize Aerospike solutions.
  • Provide expert guidance on best practices for deploying, scaling, and maintaining Aerospike in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, collaborating with internal teams, including support and engineering, when needed.
  • Conduct regular technical reviews and proactively identify areas for optimization.
  • Deliver technical training and enablement to customer teams to ensure product adoption and success.
  • Advocate for customer needs by providing feedback to product management and engineering teams.
  • Assist customers in planning and executing upgrades, migrations, and scaling initiatives.
  • Monitor key performance metrics and proactively address potential risks.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customer stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the creation of documentation, knowledge base articles, and best practice guides.
  • Lead / contribute to internal tool development to drive efficiency and effectiveness across the team

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a similarly customer-facing role, ideally within enterprise software, SaaS, or infrastructure technology
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a select group of high-value accounts with a high-touch engagement model and strong attention to relationship depth over breadth
  • Strong customer-facing skills, with experience working with developers and C-Level executives.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills in distributed systems with ability to understand and address the complexities of mission-critical applications.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear, actionable language for diverse audiences
  • Hands-on experience with Aerospike or similar databases (e.g., Yugabyte, CockroachDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase, Couchbase, etc.).
  • Cloud expertise: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud.
  • Strong Linux experience is a must.
  • Strong Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience providing technical training and enablement.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and manage multiple accounts effectively.
  • A proactive, self-directed work style — you'll operate with a high degree of autonomy and need to stay organized, prioritize effectively, and follow through without close oversight
  • Collaborative and cross-functional by nature — this role requires close coordination with Sales, Support, Services, Product, and Engineering as success depends upon working well across all teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on expertise with databases: NoSQL, Relational, Distributed, MPP.
  • Knowledge of Hadoop, Spark, HBase, HDFS, Hive, and/or Impala.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages: Java, C/C++, Python, Go, etc.
  • Understanding of computing infrastructure: Networking, CPUs, SSDs, Memory, etc.

raw.description:
Come work for a large global financial and insurance products company! This is your chance !!

Start a successful career in a renowned company in the international market! Great opportunity!

Global insurance and asset management company seeks a responsible, organized, dynamic and team-oriented person.

We are lookingfor an experienced IT Service Continuity and Disaster Recovery (DR)Governance Specialist to support an international operational resilienceprogram. You will be responsible for the governance, assurance, and continuousimprovement of DR and IT Service Continuity across applications, IT services,cloud platforms, and infrastructure.

This is agovernance and assurance role, not a technical recovery delivery role. Technology and service owners remain accountable for designing,maintaining, and executing their recovery solutions. You set expectations,assess readiness, challenge gaps and assumptions, coordinate exercises,validate evidence, track remediation, and report transparently on recoveryhealth and risk.

Key Responsibilities

DR Governance

  • Operate the DR and IT ServiceContinuity governance framework, including standards, procedures, templates,assessment criteria, and minimum evidence requirements;
  • Ensure applications andservices are governed according to criticality, Business Impact Analysis (BIA)results, RTO, and RPO;
  • Establish clear accountabilityfor DR planning, capability, testing, and remediation; monitor compliance andescalate material gaps.

DR Plan Assurance

  • Review DR plans againstorganizational requirements and industry practice, checking scope, RTO/RPO,roles, technical and third-party dependencies, recovery sequencing, validation,and failback;
  • Challenge recovery assumptionsthat are not supported by technical capability or evidence, and flagincomplete, outdated, or inconsistent documentation.

Cloud and Infrastructure Resilience

  • Assess recovery strategiesacross cloud, hybrid, and traditional environments, including geographicresilience, backup and restoration, replication, alternate-region capability,and critical dependencies (network, DNS, identity, database, storage, middleware,integration);
  • Apply enough platform knowledge(e.g., Microsoft Azure) to challenge assumptions and spot resiliencegaps, partnering with engineering and architecture teams without owning theirsolutions.

DR Exercises

  • Run the DR exercise program:define frequency, scope, objectives, success criteria, and evidencerequirements;
  • Coordinate walkthroughs,tabletop, technical, and cross-functional exercises, and push toward demonstratedtechnical recovery where criticality warrants;
  • Independently assess resultsand verify evidence of RTO, RPO, and technical and business validation; flagsuccessful tests that lack supporting evidence.

Recovery Health, Risk, and Remediation

  • Escalate overdue actions and material recoveryrisks through governance channels;
  • Assess DR readiness andmaintain visibility of documentation, demonstrated capability, open recoveryrisks, exercise results, and corrective actions;
  • Assign findings to accountableowners and track remediation to closure, validating closure evidence ratherthan relying on owner attestation.

Standards and Reporting

  • Apply ISO 22301, NIST(Cybersecurity Framework and contingency guidance), and IT Service ContinuityManagement practices, translating them into practical criteria for technologyteams. Stay current on cloud resilience, cyber recovery, and regulatoryexpectations;
  • Build DR metrics and dashboardsthat give leadership a clear view of readiness, risks, and overdue actions;turn complex technical issues into concise risk statements; and identifyrecurring weaknesses to drive improvement.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build effective relationshipswith application and service owners, infrastructure and cloud teams,Cybersecurity, architecture, vendors, and technology leadership;
  • Communicate expectationsclearly, challenge constructively, and coach teams without taking over theirrecovery responsibilities;
  • Coordinate with BusinessContinuity so BIA requirements inform IT recovery requirements, and supportCrisis Management during significant events.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Disaster Recovery, IT Service Continuity, technology oroperational resilience, or technology risk;
  • Strong knowledge of DRgovernance, planning, testing, assurance, and remediation, including RTO, RPO,backup and restoration, replication, failover/failback, recovery sequencing,and dependencies;
  • Working knowledge of cloud andinfrastructure technologies (Azure or comparable) sufficient to assess andchallenge recovery strategies;
  • Experience reviewing technicalDR plans, coordinating and assessing DR exercises, and applying DR standards,controls, or assessment criteria;
  • Ability to distinguish documentedfrom demonstrated recovery capability;
  • Knowledge of NIST frameworks,ISO 22301, and IT Service Continuity Management;
  • Experience identifying risks,setting corrective actions, tracking remediation, and validating closure;
  • Strong analytical, stakeholdermanagement, facilitation, and communication skills, with technical specialistsand senior leaders alike;
  • Ability to manage multipleassessments, exercises, and findings at once;
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) and proven experience with international,multicultural teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a regulatedenvironment (financial services, insurance, banking) and in large, complextechnology landscapes;
  • Understanding of Azureresilience and recovery architecture; familiarity with Infrastructure as Code,recovery automation, and modern application architectures;
  • Experience with ServiceNow,CMDB/service mapping, or GRC platforms;
  • Experience with cyber andransomware recovery governance;
  • Experience building DRdashboards, control frameworks, or maturity models;
  • Experience facilitating complexrecovery exercises across multiple teams and third parties.

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’sdegree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, BusinessAdministration, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent professionalexperience;
  • Preferredcertifications: BCI and/or DRII, ISO 22301, Microsoft Azure, AWS, ITIL, ortechnology risk and cybersecurity certifications. Practical DR governanceexperience matters more than certification alone.

What Success Looks Like

  • Governing recovery withoutbecoming the recovery owner;
  • Knowing enough technically tochallenge owners and engineers without doing their engineering;
  • Asking for evidence rather thanaccepting unsupported claims that a service is recoverable;
  • Holding owners accountable torequirements, actions, and deadlines;
  • Translating technical recoverygaps into business and operational risk;
  • Building constructiverelationships while maintaining independent challenge;
  • Working with limited day-to-daydirection to drive evidence-based DR maturity.

You will help maintain and improve our hybrid infrastructure, combining company-managed bare-metal environments with cloud services. Your focus will be on infrastructure reliability, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, monitoring, and observability.

Working closely with Engineering and Security teams, you'll contribute to shared infrastructure initiatives, support production operations, and help engineering teams take greater ownership of their tools and workflows. This is a hands-on technical role with opportunities to propose improvements, influence engineering practices, and contribute directly to the stability and performance of our platform.

About Ellucian

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.


About the Opportunity

At Ellucian, we're transforming how higher education experiences technology, helping colleges and universities modernize their operations, improve institutional outcomes, and realize the full value of innovation through our expanding portfolio of SaaS and AI-enabled solutions.
As a Solutions Specialist – Recruiting, Admissions & Advancement within our Solution Sales Organization, you will play a critical role in accelerating adoption and revenue growth across Ellucian's Recruiting, Admissions, and Advancement capabilities.
Combining deep expertise in higher education recruitment, admissions, enrollment management, alumni engagement, and institutional advancement with commercial acumen and consultative selling skills, you will help institutions strengthen prospective student engagement, improve recruitment effectiveness, streamline admissions processes, and deepen alumni and donor relationships.
This is a commercially focused, quota-bearing role with three core accountabilities: winning opportunities within Recruiting, Admissions, and Advancement, proactively building pipeline, and maintaining a close, structured partnership with Product Management.
Working across regions alongside our sales teams, you will bring specialist expertise to customer conversations, engage senior institutional stakeholders, and help institutions understand how connected, data-informed solutions can support enrollment growth, constituent engagement, and fundraising outcomes.

Where You Will Make an Impact

Win Opportunities Within Recruiting, Admissions & Advancement

The Value Based Coder II is an experienced professional within the Quality Management/Risk team, responsible for independently reviewing patient medical records to identify, assess, monitor, and review coding opportunities, with a growing emphasis on Hierarchical Condition Categories (HCC). This role focuses on developing and delivering provider education and contributing to process improvement initiatives. The Value Based Coder II acts as a valuable resource in identifying clinically appropriate risk-adjusting conditions and supporting provider documentation improvement.

1. Comprehensive Record Review & HCC Expertise: Independently review patient medical record information via population health tools on both a retroactive and prospective basis to identify, assess, monitor, and review network coding opportunities as it pertains to risk adjustment and HCC. Validate the accuracy and completeness of HCC documentation and coding.2. Advanced Documentation Improvement & Education: Analyze clinical documentation across the network to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement related to HCC capture. Develop and deliver effective education materials and tools to help network providers improve clinical documentation and support Hierarchical Condition Category coding capture. Provide targeted provider 1:1 education on documentation best practices, HCC guidelines, and risk adjustment principles.3. Compliance & Regulatory Insight: Continuously monitor and interpret evolving HCC coding guidelines, CMS regulations, and compliance trends within the risk adjustment landscape, applying this knowledge to daily coding and education efforts. Champion a culture of compliance by advocating for best practices and providing robust provider support to ensure CommonSpirit adheres to all federal and coding guidelines pertaining to HCC and risk adjustment. Safeguard medical records and preserve the confidentiality of personal health information through adherence to all relevant policies (release of medical record information, record retention, HIPAA privacy and security).4. Process Improvement & Collaboration: Actively participate in network performance improvement initiatives, offering insights and solutions based on coding expertise. Collaborate with providers and office staff to address documentation deficiencies and coding gaps.

Job Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in outpatient coding● 2+ years focused on risk adjustment and HCC principles.
  • Advanced knowledge of CPT and ICD-10 coding, with significant expertise in HCC codingguidelines and risk adjustment models.● Strong understanding of federal and state guidelines on all coding systems and sponsored programs.● Proficiency in developing and delivering educational content.● Effective interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills (both verbal and written).● Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.● Computer literacy in medical information systems, records management software, and encoder software.

Preferred/Desired Experience● 4+ years of experience in outpatient coding,● 3+ years focused on risk adjustment and HCC principles

Where You’ll Work

Baylor St. Luke’s Medical Center is an 881-bed quaternary care academic medical center that is a joint venture between Baylor College of Medicine and CHI St. Luke’s Health. Located in the Texas Medical Center, the hospital is the home of the Texas Heart® Institute, a cardiovascular research and education institution founded in 1962 by Denton A. Cooley, MD. The hospital was the first facility in Texas and the Southwest designated a Magnet® hospital for Nursing Excellence by the American Nurses Credentialing Center, receiving the award five consecutive times. Baylor St. Luke’s also has three community emergency centers offering adult and pediatric care for the Greater Houston area.

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Principal Cloud & Infrastructure Architect (Level 4 – Hands-On Technical) to serve as the primary technical authority and hands-on technical lead across company's infrastructure, network operations, cloud, endpoint, and security platforms—including the end-to-end connectivity that 300+ billable agents (WFH and in-office) and 80+ internal staff use to access US- and Australia-based client ERP environments.

Working directly alongside our 5-person internal IT team (IT Operations Supervisor, System Administrator, Systems Engineers, and Network Engineer), you will act as a true player-coach: setting the architectural standards, automation, and security guardrails that the team runs on, while leading from the front in high priority incident troubleshooting, root-cause diagnostics, and daily technical mentorship. This role requires deep hands-on technical superiority, operational urgency, and the ability to transform an incident-driven team into proactive systems owners. He will be a Hands-On Technical Lead.

Core Technology Stack: WatchGuard Firebox/Cloud, Cisco switching/routing, Microsoft 365, Azure & Entra ID, Microsoft Intune & Windows Autopilot, Wazuh SIEM, NinjaOne RMM, PowerShell / Python / Git, and Jira Service Management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Network & Client Connectivity Architecture

  • Multi-Client VPN/SD-WAN Blueprint: Design and own the reference architecture for client connectivity across WatchGuard and Cisco platforms—covering site-to-site and remote-access VPN topologies, SD-WAN policies, and per-client segmentation—so every new client onboards on a repeatable, documented pattern rather than a one-off build.
  • Routing & Resilience Strategy: Define and implement standards for split tunneling, QoS, dual-ISP failover, and bandwidth optimization across distributed WFH and in-office environments connecting to North American and Australian client systems.
  • Firewall & Network Security Standards: Author WatchGuard and Cisco firewall rule-base standards, hardening baselines, and change-approval criteria, guiding the System Administrator and Network Engineer in day-to-day execution.
  • Proactive Diagnostic Engineering: Lead deep packet-level and telemetry analysis (packet loss, latency jitter, hop-by-hop traceroutes, MTU/fragmentation, VPN/firewall logs, and endpoint resource metrics) to isolate chronic bottlenecks between home ISPs, office firewalls, and clientVPNs—turning recurring issues into permanent design fixes.
  • Resilience & DR Architecture: Define backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity architecture, RPO/RTO targets, and DR testing frameworks, overseeing periodic backup validation and post-incident reviews.

2. Cloud, Identity & Endpoint Architecture

  • Azure & Entra ID Administration: Architect and govern the Azure and Microsoft 365 tenant, hybrid identity model, Conditional Access policies, and privileged access controls.
  • Intune Zero-Touch Deployment: Design and maintain Windows Autopilot and Microsoft Intune zero-touch provisioning—including enrollment profiles, compliance baselines, automated OS patching rings, disk/storage cleanup policies, local admin restrictions, and hardware lifecycle governance—so remote laptops ship ready and compliant without manual IT builds.
  • RMM & Infrastructure Visibility (NinjaOne): Oversee the configuration and optimization of NinjaOne RMM for proactive endpoint health monitoring, automated remediation, patching, and alerting.

3. Security Monitoring & Compliance Alignment

  • Wazuh SIEM & Detection Engineering: Architect and tune the Wazuh SIEM deployment across WatchGuard, Cisco, Entra ID, M365, and endpoint log sources—building decoders, detection rules, alert thresholds, and automated escalation playbooks.
  • Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Map technical controls to ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and client contractual security requirements, remediating architectural and control gaps uncovered in internal/external audits or penetration tests.

4. Automation & ITSM Engineering

  • PowerShell / Python Automation: Build and maintain the team's automation library (user onboarding/offboarding, Entra ID and Intune configuration-as-code via Microsoft Graph SDK, firewall config backups, and automated health checks) to eliminate repetitive manual BAU work.
  • Engineering Discipline: Maintain all automation scripts under Git version control with code review, testing, and clear runbook documentation so the team can safely execute and maintain them.
  • Jira Service Management Optimization: Design Jira workflows, SLAs, automation rules, and operational dashboards, integrating NinjaOne and Wazuh alerts directly into Jira for automated ticket routing.

5. AI & MCP Security Governance

  • AI Productivity Tool Controls: Define and enforce technical guardrails for internal AI tools (e.g., Claude Cowork, Cursor), including approved tool lists, data classification rules, Microsoft 365 DLP policies, and endpoint sandboxing.
  • MCP Connector Security: Govern Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and API connectors— enforcing least-privilege and read-only scopes, Entra ID app consent and OAuth controls, audit logging into Wazuh, and mitigations against prompt injection and data exfiltration.

6. Hands-On Escalation & Technical Leadership (Player-Coach)

  • Lead by Doing (L4 Escalation): Serve as the final hands-on technical escalation point for critical outages, complex client VPN failures, and high-severity security incidents—jumping directly into the CLI, packet captures, or logs alongside the team when things break.
  • Culture Transformation: Shift the IT team from reactive ticket-takers to proactive systems owners who identify and eliminate root causes before they impact agent throughput or SLAs.
  • Granular Mentorship & Accountability: Run daily technical stand-ups, review ticket diagnostics and root-cause analyses line-by-line with the engineers (Supervisor, SysAdmin, Systems Engineers, and Network Engineer), and coach the team on cloud, scripting, and architectural best practices.
  • Roadmap & Standards Governance: Own architecture decision records (ADRs), network diagrams, standard build templates, capacity planning, and technical vendor evaluations.

REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Proven Technical Superiority: Deeper hands-on engineering mastery across cloud, networking, security, and scripting than everyone on the current team, commanding natural technical respect and authority.
  • Network & Security Stack: Expert-level WatchGuard (Firebox policies, BOVPN, SD-WAN, WatchGuard Cloud) and Cisco (routing, switching, VLANs, security) architecture and troubleshooting.
  • Microsoft Cloud & MDM: Advanced Azure, Entra ID (Conditional Access, privileged access, hybrid identity), Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and M365 security/DLP.
  • Deep Diagnostic Engineering: Ability to interpret ping payload behavior (packet loss, jitter), traceroute hop latency spikes, MTU/fragmentation issues, routing loops, and firewall/VPN telemetry to isolate last-mile ISP vs. core network bottlenecks.
  • Automation & Scripting: Advanced PowerShell (including Microsoft Graph SDK) and Python, REST APIs, and Git version control (Bicep or Terraform is a plus).
  • SIEM & RMM Operations: Hands-on Wazuh SIEM deployment/rule tuning and NinjaOne RMM administration.
  • AI & MCP Security: Practical understanding of LLM/agentic tool risks (prompt injection, data leakage, over-scoped OAuth/MCP permissions) and how to lock them down.
  • High Operational Urgency: Relentless focus on system uptime, rapid incident resolution, and zero tolerance for recurring unaddressed infrastructure bugs.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience: 10+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, network engineering, cloud, or systems engineering, including 4+ years operating at a Principal / Senior Architect (L4) or hands-on Technical Lead level.
  • Environment Background:Proven track record in a fast-paced BPO, Managed Services Provider (MSP), or multi-tenant enterprise environment supporting distributed/WFH workforces and international client connectivity.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics/Communications Engineering, or a related technical field.

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you will play an integral role in the customer journey by delivering exceptional service across phone and email channels within a fast-paced financial services contact center. You will serve as a customer advocate, demonstrating empathy, patience, and active listening to ensure every customer feels heard, valued, and supported.

This role requires strong critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently to resolve customer loan inquiries accurately and efficiently. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to address complex customer concerns while maintaining ownership of the customer experience.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven, with a commitment to continuous improvement, professional development, and going above and beyond to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

raw.description:
Senior Manager, PPC & SEM

Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Manager of PPC & SEM to help us change the way the world works, withParallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about the Senior Manager, PPC & SEM role and see if we’re destined to be together.

As a Senior Manager of PPC & SEM, you will:

Own SEM Strategy & Performance

  • Own paid search strategy across Google Ads and other PPC platforms (Meta, Linkedin, Reddit etc), with accountability for revenue, ROAS, CAC, conversion, and growth efficiency.
  • Set budget, bidding, campaign structure, keyword and query strategy, audience use, and geographic priorities based on business goals.
  • Assess the right level of SEM investment and recommend where to scale, reduce, or reallocate spend.
  • Build scenarios around changes in search behavior, AI-driven discovery, competitor activity, and branded versus non-branded demand.

Be Deeply Hands-On in the Platforms

  • Work directly in Google Ads on campaign builds, bidding, budgets, search terms, negatives, targeting, creative, assets, and ongoing optimization.
  • Diagnose performance changes quickly and separate demand shifts, auction dynamics, tracking issues, landing-page friction, and execution problems.
  • Maintain strong account hygiene, testing discipline, QA, and operational pace across campaigns and markets.
  • Work closely with the SEM manager to ensure high-quality day-to-day execution while retaining direct visibility into the details.

Build the Experimentation Roadmap

  • Define and run structured tests across bidding, targeting, keywords, creative, landing pages, offers, audiences, geographies, and campaign types.
  • Create clear hypotheses, success metrics, test design, and readouts so learnings can be scaled rather than remaining one-off optimizations.
  • Use incrementality testing, holdouts, geo tests, or other practical approaches where possible to understand true business impact.
  • Partner with Web and Creative teams to improve the full path from ad click through landing page, trial, and purchase.

Expand Beyond Search

  • Bring working experience across paid social and other PPC platforms such as Meta/Instagram, Reddit, and LinkedIn.
  • Identify where these channels can complement Search through audience discovery, retargeting, demand creation, or upper-funnel experimentation.
  • Design disciplined pilots with clear budgets, audiences, creative hypotheses, measurement plans, and stop/scale criteria.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on incrementality and commercial impact.

Own Measurement & Business Insight

  • Translate platform data into clear business insights on revenue, ROAS, CAC, conversion, marginal returns, and customer acquisition quality.
  • Build useful reporting by campaign type, brand/non-brand, geography, audience, device, and funnel stage.
  • Partner with Analytics to improve attribution, tracking, experiment measurement, and visibility into downstream customer value.
  • Communicate performance, risks, opportunities, and investment recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

Partner Across Growth

  • Work closely with SEO/GEO to understand how organic search, AI answers, paid placements, and branded demand interact, and share search-query, competitor, and customer-intent insights across Growth.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Creative on messaging, value propositions, proof points, and ad/landing-page creative.

What YOU bring to the team:

  • 7+ years of hands-on PPC/performance marketing experience, with deep expertise in SEM and significant direct experience managing Google Ads.
  • Strong working knowledge of paid platforms such as Meta/Instagram, Reddit, and LinkedIn.
  • Proven track record managing multi-million$ paid media budgets and improving revenue, ROAS, CAC, or other commercial outcomes.
  • Expertise in search campaign architecture, keyword/query strategy, match types, bidding, budgets, audiences, creative testing, and optimization.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with attribution, incrementality, marginal returns, funnel conversion, and performance forecasting.
  • Experience designing and executing structured experiments, not just making continuous platform optimizations.
  • Strategic judgment: able to form a view on where the market is going, what it means for paid acquisition, and how investment should change.
  • Execution mindset: willing to get into accounts, reports, search terms, campaigns, and tests personally rather than operating only through others.
  • Experience in SaaS, subscription software, ecommerce, or digital products is highly relevant.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional skills, with the ability to turn complex performance data into simple recommendations and actions.
  • Comfort operating in a global, fast-moving environment with multiple markets, stakeholders, and competing priorities.

US:

  • Parallels features award-winning solutions that have helped millions of users for 40 years (can you believe it?!).
  • We have millions of users and decades of innovation under our belts.
  • We offer a fully remote workspace. There is no pressure to work in an office whatsoever.
  • Hours are flexible, too! You’ve worked hard to build your life, and we don’t want you to give it up for work.
  • Our team is growing fast, and there’s a tonof energy and a lot of really smart, motivated, fun people ready to welcome you in.

What are you waiting for? Apply now! We can’t wait to meet you.

(FYI, we’re lucky to have a lot of interest and we soappreciate your application, though please note that we’ll only contact you if you’ve been selected for an interview.)

About Parallels

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it’s desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels has a solution to help your company optimize the speed and security of your work environment at an affordable price.

Our products enable millions of connected knowledge workers around the world to do great work faster. Our success is driven by an unwavering commitment to deliver a broad portfolio of innovative applications – including Parallels RAS, Parallels Desktop Enterprise, and Parallels DaaS, among others.

It is our policy and practice to offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

Parallels is committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodation that are required. Appropriate accommodation will be provided upon request as required by Federal and Provincial regulations and Company Policy. Any information received relating to accommodation will be treated as confidential.

As part of our evaluation process, we utilize an AI tool to assess candidates.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPointCorp seeks Help Desk Specialists to provide non-technical application and user support for the Defense Casualty Information Processing System (DCIPS) Future. You will help authorized users navigate the application, follow documented business workflows, and use available self-service and training resources to help customers towards a resolution within the system.

The role combines initial contact and procedure-based Tier 1/2 assistance. The goal is first-contact resolution when an approved answer or procedure is available. You will use knowledge articles, job aids and training videos rather than being expected to serve as a casualty-management subject matter expert or technical administrator.

You will report to the dedicated Help Desk Lead. Questions requiring specialist judgment, including niche Baseline 1.0 functionality, will be routed to the designated Business Analyst and Senior Advisor teams under the program’s Tier 3/4 escalation model.

Job Description:

Head of Product

ProviderSoft

THE COMPANY

ProviderSoft has spent two decades building software for early childhood developmental therapy agencies, a stable and specialized niche where our customers serve children and families who depend on quality care. We are profitable and capital-efficient, with a loyal customer base and a 20-plus-year operating track record. Our mission is to empower Early Childhood Development providers with the software, service, and expertise they need to achieve operational excellence, so they can deliver the highest quality care to children and families in their communities.

POSITION

ProviderSoft builds the solution agencies use to run early intervention, preschool special education, and applied behavior analysis (ABA) programs: therapy and support for young children with developmental delays and their families. Our clients run on thin margins inside a reimbursement system they don't control, so every hour of administrative work we remove goes back to their margin or to clinician time with a child.

We're building a new platform to replace a 20-year-old product. Our clients' workflows span case management, documentation, billing and state reporting, with real variation by state and program. The aim is a product that brings the work to the user, in place of users navigating a system to get their work done. The approach: start with the highest-value pieces, learn from clients and build from there.

The Head of Product is the primary person driving the definition of the new platform, and leads discovery, design and product for both the new and the existing platform. Product management and UX design report to this role, and it sits on the leadership team alongside Advisory, Operations, Sales and Marketing, and Engineering.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and grow the product and design team and build how product decisions get made, product management is a new function here.
  • Serve on the leadership team and lead the product steering committee that governs new product work and recommends what we pursue.
  • Set discovery goals (OKRs) for what we need to learn and decide and report progress to leadership.
  • Own the product definition and roadmap for the new platform and the existing product.
  • Lead discovery, customer research, competitive research, client segmentation, and the case for what we build.
  • Sequence which modules and features come first, starting with value clients see right away, and what we decline.
  • Run our customer development partner program, where several customers help shape each module as it is designed.
  • Build the delivery plan with engineering and design, and bring the product side of it: scope, sequence and tradeoffs, with a backlog ready ahead of the team.
  • Plan rollout and migration for existing customers with our implementation and Client Services teams.
  • Help shape how we use AI across product and engineering, practically and safely.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Senior product leadership experience in B2B or vertical SaaS, including at least one product taken from concept through production release.
  • Experience leading product management and UX design teams.
  • Experience defining requirements for complex, workflow-driven platforms such as case management, scheduling, billing or compliance reporting.
  • Skill at deciding what not to build, and at holding that decision.
  • Experience delivering on a dated commitment as part of a cross-functional team.
  • A strong point of view on building products in the age of AI and demonstrated impact from it.
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating what you learn into a roadmap engineering can act on.
  • Strong written communication, and the ability to tell a story that creates alignment.
  • Healthcare, human services or other regulated-industry SaaS experience preferred; Early Intervention expertise is not required, and deep domain expertise is in house.

Business Unit:

ProviderSoft

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

raw.excerpt: Job Description NANA Management Services is seeking a Remote Security Officer to support Maniilaq Housing in Kotzebue, Alaska.
raw.description:
Job Description

NANA Management Services is seeking a Remote Security Officer to support Maniilaq Housing in Kotzebue, Alaska. This position is responsible for remotely monitoring housing properties, coordinating responses to incidents with on-site staff and emergency services, and maintaining detailed records of all security activities.

The ideal candidate will have security or law enforcement experience, strong communication skills, cultural awareness, and an understanding of rural Alaska communities. This role plays a vital part in protecting residents, preserving property, and supporting the overall safety and well-being of the Kotzebue community from a remote operations setting.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and patrol assigned buildings, grounds, and areas, either visually or electronically.
  • Control access to the property, allowing entry only to properly authorized individuals.
  • Inspect premises, including doors, windows, and gates, to ensure they are secure.
  • Document and report incidents such as property damage, safety hazards, or unusual occurrences.
  • Warn violators of rule infractions and, when necessary, escort them from the property.
  • Notify on-site staff when visitors or service providers arrive.
  • Assist in responding to emergencies or disasters to protect life, property, and community safety.
  • Check the heating, lighting, sprinklers, ventilation, and fire safety systems to ensure proper function.
  • Provide transportation services using a variety of vehicles, including passenger cars, and passenger vans.
  • Administer emergency medical aid, including CPR, AED use, and safe patient movement.
  • Reporting any safety or sanitation concerns to a supervisor promptly.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the department’s and community’s success.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record for the past three (3) years (per NMS vehicle insurance policy).
  • Ability to obtain an Alaska Guard License (fee of $97.00, paid by applicant) prior to employment.
  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office and contract-specific software.
  • Must pass all pre-employment contract requirements, which may include:
    • Hair follicle drug test
    • Physical and fit-for-duty assessment
    • Hearing test
    • Applicants not located near a testing facility are responsible for travel expenses to the nearest facility.
  • Ability to work respectfully and effectively in a multicultural environment, with an understanding of Alaska Native cultures and rural community life.
  • Ability to make sound decisions in real time with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to stand and be on your feet for 12 hours per shift, according to the scheduled rotation.
  • Contract requires the ability to speak, read, write, and understand English.
  • Must meet and adhere to all safety guidelines and regulations set by the company and client.

CANDIDATES RESIDING OUTSIDE ANCHORAGE AREA:

Candidates residing in the Lower 48 for any contract: For the purposes of pre-employment testing, Anchorage will be considered the point of hire (with the exception of drug testing, which will be conducted near the candidate’s place of residence). Employee is responsible for any travel expenses and needed accommodations related to pre−employment tasks that need to be completed in Anchorage, AK. This includes, but is not limited to, any safety training requirements, required pre−employment testing and/or training such as physical, DOT physical/medical card, fit for duty, audiogram, and/or other testing required by contract/company (such as NSTC, APICC training, security licensing requirements, etc.

Candidates residing in Alaska for Alyeska and Hillcorp contracts: pre-employment testing will be scheduled near the candidate’s area of residence within the state. The only exception is when the candidate lives in a region without the necessary service providers to complete all requirements.

Flights to Remote Locations: All employees are responsible for all expenses related to reporting to point of hire (Anchorage, AK) for scheduled trips paid for by the company for remote locations.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

Weather: Indoors and outdoors, frequently exposed to arctic weather conditions.

Noise level: Moderate.

Description of environment: Environment will vary based on the facility assigned to.

Physical requirements: Employee is required to lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. Frequently to constantly required to sit, stand, walk, use hands/fingers to handle or feel, climb, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk/hear, see, taste/smell, and carry weight/lift.

Fit For Duty Test Fit For Duty light requirement

  • Lift: Lift 20 lbs. from floor to knuckle x 2,
  • Lift: Lift 20 lbs. from floor to waist x 2,
  • Carry: Carry 20 lbs. with two hands for a minimum distance of 20 feet, self-paced but continuous,
  • Kneel: Kneel on one knee and stand. Return to kneel on opposite knee. Repeat alternate kneeling sequence x 3 for each knee, self-paced but continuous,
  • Stand from Supine Position Test: From a supine, recumbent position, while wearing arctic gear, test recipient must be able to stand without assistance x 3, self-paced (this task must be accomplished safely without significant loss of balance or falling and without assistance). Allow one re-test when there is a loss of balance considered unsafe or a fall.)
  • Stoop & Twist: Perform alternate cross over toe touches x 5 each side, self-paced but continuous,
  • Walk: Walk on a treadmill at 3 MPH for 10 minutes with good balance
  • Stairs: Climb up and down 10 steps x 2 for a total of 20 steps, self-paced.

Competencies

  • Customer Service – Provides outstanding customer service; manages difficult or emotional situations; responds promptly to customer needs; responds to requests for service and assistance; meets commitments in a timely manner.
  • Interpersonal Skills – Focuses on solving conflict; maintains confidentiality; listens to others without interrupting; keeps emotions under control; remains open to other ideas.
  • Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; demonstrates group presentation skills; participates in meetings.
  • Written Communication – Writes incidents, logs and other reports clearly; able to read and interpret written information.

raw.description:
Director of FP&A (Finance)

Why You Should Choose Steno

When you join Steno, you're not just joining a finance team - you're joining a company that:

  • Wins together – Stock options included. When Steno grows, you grow.
  • Invests in you – Premium Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage — options for you and your family, with generous employer contributions toward premiums.
  • Supports your wellbeing – Wellness and mental health benefits to be used among employees and families.
  • Operates with integrity – We value long-term partnerships over short-term wins.
  • Constantly innovates with technology at our core – We are a modern organization solving real problems in an industry that needs a revolutionary approach.
  • Gives you room to build – You own your domain, drive your own agenda, and serve as a true thought partner to leadership.

About the Role

Steno is looking for a Director of FP&A to own how the company plans, spends and invests. We are both a litigation support services provider and a technology company, so every dollar has to compete across service delivery capacity, GTM headcount, product development and G&A. You will build the planning and spend management system that makes those tradeoffs explicit: a credible annual plan, department-level budget accountability, and a clear ROI bar for material investments. Your work will tell leadership where to put the next dollar and where to pull one back. You’ll report to the SVP of Finance and partner closely with department leaders across the organization.

Who You Are

You read financial outcomes through a business-first lens. When something moves in the P&L, you ask what happened upstream in service delivery, GTM capacity, pricing or mix, or a people , vendor or investment decision, not only what changed in the model. You ask what a dollar of spend is returning before you ask whether it fits the budget and turn messy operational data into a short narrative leaders can use.

On a regular basis you will

  • Lead the annual operating plan and budget, reconciling top-down targets with bottoms-up department plans and ending with clear spend budgets each department owns.
  • Run monthly department-level budget-vs-actual reviews with each leader: explain variances, hold owners accountable and re-forecast where needed.
  • Build and own the ROI and payback framework for material investments (headcount, vendors, GTM programs, technology), and evaluate requests against it before they’re approved.
  • Run post-investment reviews to see whether approved investments delivered the expected return, and use the results to inform the next round of decisions.
  • Identify reallocation opportunities by benchmarking spend efficiency across departments and vendors, and recommend where to invest more, hold steady or cut.
  • Partner with People and department leaders on workforce planning so every hire ties to capacity, productivity or revenue impact.
  • Maintain a driver-based operating model that links headcount, spend and capacity drivers to the P&L and cash, including the forecast.
  • Strengthen spend governance (approval thresholds, procurement workflow, vendor management) as Steno scales.

You're gonna crush it if

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A or operating finance at a scaling company with real operational complexity.
  • You have a track record owning budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis end-to-end – not only contributing to someone else's process.
  • You have strong financial modeling skills and excellent Excel / Google Sheets; you build models others can follow and use.
  • You use AI and automation to take manual work out of the planning cycle. You’ve used AI tools (LLMs, workflow automation, AI features in your planning stack) to speed up budget-vs-actual reporting, variance commentary, forecasting or spend reviews, so your team spends its time on analysis and decisions rather than gathering data.
  • You have built or run spend governance, investment review or ROI frameworks that changed how leaders allocate resources.
  • You're comfortable operating where data and process are still maturing, with a bias toward improving the planning system while hitting the calendar.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and speaking, and you're highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Experience in tech-enabled services, marketplace, SaaS, legal tech, or a similarly complex operating environment is highly valued.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary - $170,000 - $230,000
  • Health, Vision, & Dental Benefits — generous, low-cost plans for employees and their families
  • Wellness & Mental Health — shared benefits designed to support the whole person
  • Flexible Paid Time Off — trust-based and meant to be used
  • Equity options — so you share in what we're building
  • Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
  • Home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

Application Information

  • Steno is an equal opportunity employer; we do not discriminate on the basis of characteristics protected by law. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • Applicants needing special assistance or accommodations for interviews or website access should contact us at .
  • Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information included in an application, is collected, analyzed, and stored in our system.
  • Steno personnel will always have a email or contact you via Rippling Recruiting. Background checks are only conducted after an offer is extended. If you haven’t received an expected communication, check your spam.
  • Steno uses AI-assisted tools for this role to identify and prioritize candidates whose experience aligns with the role. All hiring decisions are made by our People team.

Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Sr. Compensation Analyst, you will support our compensation programs from plan design through implementation and ongoing administration, acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert.Every day, you will apply solid knowledge of compensation (base and variable pay) and data to provide critical analytical insight that informs compensation-related decisions and programs. You will provide comprehensive analytical support, ongoing research, modeling, and in-depth compensation analysis for base pay and incentive programs. Your responsibilities include evaluating jobs, completing market pricing, determining pay grades, completing compensation surveys, and performing associated analyses by applying standard job evaluation methodologies. You will ensure compensation-related programs and practices are competitive, equitable, and in compliance with all regulatory requirements. As a trusted advisor, you will consult with leaders on various compensation issues and actively mentor and guide compensation analysts and specialists, potentially serving as the point of contact for smaller markets or service lines.To be successful in this role, you will possess extensive experience as a compensation analyst, demonstrating a deep understanding of compensation plan design, market pricing, job evaluation methodologies, and regulatory compliance. You will exhibit exceptional analytical skills, meticulous attention to detail, and proficiency in data modeling and statistical analysis.

  • Supports the planning, development and implementation of new and revised CSH compensation programs to meet the organization's goals and competitive practices. Provides analytic support for CSH compensation program management and implementation, including but not limited to: base pay administration, annual salary increase processes, variable pay program administration, special pay practices and ad-hoc compensation projects. Facilitates the delivery, education and communication of compensation programs.
  • Participates and/or completes salary surveys, analyzes salary survey results, and assists with the design or revision of salary structures. Reviews and consults with human resources or managers on new or revised jobs, conducts job evaluations, determines FLSA status, and provides salary recommendations to ensure internal equity and market alignment.
  • Prepares regular and ad-hoc reports regarding market compensation data, special pay practices and internal company compensation information. Participates in special projects as assigned, including executive compensation analysis, labor negotiations support and merger and acquisition activities.
  • Partners with HR COE’s, HR Technology and other CSH colleagues to ensure continuous improvement of processes and technology in support of compensation programs. Identifies issues and concerns and offers options of potential solutions for problem solving. Ensures accuracy of compensation-related data that is maintained within company information systems and databases.

Job Requirements

Required

  • Bachelors Other Five (5) years of related job or industry experience in lieu of degree.
  • Four (4) years progressive compensation or analytics experience

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

Ready to Build Your Future with Us?

Publishing Editor, Open Access – $70,304 – Permanent

Join us and be part of a mission-driven, independent publisher. You’ll work with a diverse group of people who share a passion for empowering researchers, educators, and institutions to shape the future.

About Sage:

Sage is a global academic publisher of books, journals, and library resources with a growing range of technologies to enable discovery, access, and engagement. Believing that research and education are critical in shaping society, Sara Miller McCune founded Sage in 1965. Today, we are controlled by a group of trustees charged with maintaining our independence and mission indefinitely.

Our guaranteed independence means we’re free to:

  • Do more – supporting an equitable academic future, furthering disciplines that drive social change, and helping social and behavioural science make an impact

  • Work together – building lasting relationships, championing diverse perspectives, and co-creating resources to transform teaching and learning

  • Think long-term – experimenting, taking risks, and investing in new ideas

Our Publishing Editor team is a highly motivated, hard-working, and collaborative group within Sage’s Open Access Journals division - one of the most dynamic and rapidly expanding areas of the business. We pride ourselves on being both professional and approachable, creating a supportive and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Each Publishing Editor manages a varied portfolio of journals, working closely with internal colleagues and external partners to help their titles achieve success. As publishing experts, we combine strong publishing experience with a commitment to quality, innovation, and author experience. Joining our team means contributing to the growth of a vibrant publishing programme while developing your own expertise in a fast-evolving area of scholarly communication.

Your new role:

You’ll be at the heart of shaping the future of academic research by leading a dynamic portfolio of Open Access journals - enhancing their quality, visibility, and market impact while driving financial performance. You’ll build trusted relationships with editorial boards and publishing partners, offering expert guidance and service that empowers them to thrive.

  • Set clear expectations and support journal editors with mentorship and actionable feedback.

  • Monitor journal performance, boost revenue, and manage costs to ensure sustainable growth.

  • Advise editors and society partners to improve journal impact and uphold publishing standards.

  • Lead contract renewals with editors and societies, ensuring alignment and long-term success.

  • Represent Sage at conferences and lead journal editorial board meetings with confidence and insight.

  • Partner with production, marketing, and other key teams to deliver seamless journal experiences

Could you be our new Publishing Editor? Are you:

  • Experienced in managing academic or scientific journals with a record of improving editorial performance and journal impact

  • Confident in navigating the full journal publishing lifecycle, from submission and peer review to production and distribution

  • Skilled in written and verbal communication, able to influence collaborators, negotiate contracts, and represent your organisation at industry events

  • A strategic problem solver, capable of analysing financial performance, increasing revenue, and managing costs effectively

  • A relationship-builder, known for encouraging positive relationships with editors, societies, and internal teams to drive journal success

  • Equipped to handle ethical and legal publishing challenges, ensuring compliance and integrity across all editorial activities

Application:Please apply by Wednesday 2nd December. Interviews will be arranged over Microsoft Teams shortly afterwards.

Pay Transparency & Benefits Package:

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include bonuses or benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with SAGE covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. We strive to achieve a better representation of diverse talent at all levels, including leadership, across our workforce.
